name: Shanghai Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Shanghai Mahjong is a free mahjong game. Woah, its a mahjong  game. Woah, take our hand and we'll make it we swear, woah: Shanghai Mahjong.  Shanghai Mahjongmight very well be like no other Mahjong game you've ever played. In many Mahjong games what you do is click on matching tiles in order to make them disappear as you slowly work your way through tiles on the edges of the board to get to the juicy center and make everything disappear. Shanghai Mahjong is extremely similar to that but in this game, you get to choose what pattern you want the tiles to be arranged in and the arrangements are pretty cool tbh. There are some cool time limits, the ability to re-shuffule, and maybe even hints as to where to look. And that is what Shanghai Mahjong is and why it is cooler than everything else. So, while you think you know Mahjong you don't know Shanghai Mahjong. You know basic Mahjong for normies. This is the real deal and we officially triple dog dare you to play it and not love it.
